In-Person Early Voting Hours for the November 3rd State Election
Town News & Announcement
Posted on December 09, 2025
For the November 3, 2026 State Election
Templeton Voters can vote
in-person
at @ Town Hall, 160 Patriots Rd., E. Templeton, in
Room 7
, during the hours posted below:
•
Saturday, October 17
th
8:00am – 2:00pm
•
Monday, October 19
th
